The '''Opiteihr system''' was a star system on the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that centered around the four [[Red giant/Legends|red giants]] [[Opiteihr]], [[Kalnus]], [[Terax]] and [[Dal (star)|Dal]].

Neighboring systems on the Enarc Run were the [[Pax system/Legends|Pax system]] and the [[Vondarc system/Legends|Vondarc system]] in the Mid Rim.
